en: The image shows the back of a vintage postcard. The text is primarily in Russian. There are handwritten notes in blue ink, addressed to someone and mentioning congratulations for the 1st of May (May Day). The printed text includes publication information, blank lines for the recipient's address, and a description indicating the front likely features 'Flowers of the coral tree' by photographer L. Raskina. The postcard was printed by the Pravda newspaper's print house, named after V. I. Lenin, in 1962.
